description: Estimate UK income tax and Class 4 National Insurance for a sole trader from turnover and allowable expenses, with the take-home figure, effective and marginal rates, payments on account and tailored tips, from HMRC's published rates for the tax year. Works from the figures given, without a TapTax account.

businessMiles.description: Business miles driven in a car or van, claimed at the approved mileage rate

expenses.description: Allowable business expenses, in pounds (excluding mileage if businessMiles is given)

otherIncome.description: Other taxable income such as a salary or pension, in pounds

pensionContributions.description: Personal pension contributions paid (relief at source), in pounds

taxDeductedAtSource.description: Tax already paid through PAYE or CIS deductions this year

taxYear.description: UK tax year, e.g. "2026-27" (6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027). Defaults to the current one.

turnover.description: Self-employed income before expenses, in pounds

name: estimate_self_employed_tax
title: Estimate self-employed tax
